# Wellows

> Wellows is an AI-first, autonomous marketing platform designed to maximize your brand's AI visibility and AI search visibility across AI and search. It leverages the GenAI Visibility Stack to measure and improve AI visibility, AI search visibility, and Citation Score, acting as a self-learning, always-on marketer. 
- [Wellows Homepage](https://wellows.com/): Wellows is an AI search visibility platform that acts like an autonomous marketer for your brand. Powered by the GenAI Visibility Stack, it identifies visibility gaps, prioritizes high-impact content opportunities, generates citation-worthy content, and continuously monitors and verifies AI mentions and citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Google AI Mode to improve your Citation Score.

## Wellows Overview
- [About Us](https://wellows.com/about-us/): Overview of Wellows' mission, team, and approach to building an autonomous marketing platform that enhances AI visibility across search and AI systems like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.
- [Brand Story](https://wellows.com/brand-story/): Narrative of Wellows' journey since 2011 and its vision for providing an autonomous marketing platform that maximizes your brand's AI search visibility across Google and LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. 
- [Contact Us](https://wellows.com/contact-us/): Contact information and a form to reach the Wellows team for inquiries or support regarding AI visibility strategies, Citation Score optimization, and GenAI Visibility Stack implementation.
- [Webinar](https://wellows.com/webinar/): Access and registration for Wellows' webinars on autonomous marketing platform strategies, AI search visibility, and leveraging the GenAI Visibility Stack to improve Citation Score across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.
- [Book A Demo](https://wellows.com/book-a-demo/): Book an exclusive 30-minute demo with our CEO and see how Wellows uncovers your brand’s AI visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity. Learn how AI engines perceive, cite, and rank your brand and how you can take control of your narrative inside AI search.

## Wellows Features
- [Features Overview](https://wellows.com/features/): Explore Wellows features powered by the GenAI Visibility Stack that track AI search visibility, turning citations, sentiment and intent into clear actions across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.

- [AI Writing Generator](https://wellows.com/features/content-creation/): Wellows' AI Writing Generator turns structured briefs into full-length, AI-optimized drafts that enhance AI visibility. It automates writing with LLM logic, keeping content aligned and brand-ready for improved Citation Score across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
- [Content Briefs](https://wellows.com/features/content-creation/): Wellows compiles SERP, intent, and LLM data into one structured brief using the GenAI Visibility Stack, so your team moves from keyword to strategy with speed and clarity while improving AI search visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.
- [Quick Generate](https://wellows.com/features/content-creation/): Wellows' Quick Generate turns keywords into full drafts using SERP data, People Also Ask and intent signals, creating fast, AI visibility-ready content that improves Citation Score across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
- [People Also Ask](https://wellows.com/features/content-creation/): Wellows' People Also Ask feature collects live questions from Google, Bing and Yahoo, helping you plan content that matches intent and improves AI search visibility across AI Overviews and AI Mode while enhancing Citation Score.
- [Latent Semantic Indexing (LSI)](https://wellows.com/features/content-creation/): Wellows' LSI feature finds related terms from Google and Bing, helping content feel natural while growing AI search visibility and Citation Score for brands across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.
- [Social Discussion Detector](https://wellows.com/features/content-creation/): Wellows tracks conversations on Reddit, X, LinkedIn and Quora, using sentiment and discussion insights to grow AI search visibility and inform GenAI Visibility Stack strategies that improve Citation Score.
- [LLM Visibility](https://wellows.com/features/llms-visibility/): Wellows' LLM Visibility analyzes AI queries and tone across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode, showing how models interpret topics to improve daily AI search visibility and Citation Score using the GenAI Visibility Stack.
- [SERP Visibility](https://wellows.com/features/content-creation/): Wellows' SERP Visibility shows top pages, patterns and gaps using the GenAI Visibility Stack, helping you design content that stays visible and earns more AI search visibility and citations daily across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.
- [User Search Intent](https://wellows.com/features/content-creation/): Wellows reveals the purpose behind every query using GenAI Visibility Stack insights, helping you align content with real goals and grow AI search visibility and Citation Score across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.
- [Tracking](https://wellows.com/features/prompt-tracking/): Wellows Tracking monitors brand citations, queries and sentiment across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode, providing comprehensive AI visibility insights through the GenAI Visibility Stack.
- [Monitoring](https://wellows.com/features/monitoring/): Wellows Monitoring tracks your brand's AI visibility across daily changes and competitor shifts on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode using the autonomous marketing platform's real-time capabilities.
- [Implicit Wins](https://wellows.com/features/outreach/): Wellows' Implicit Wins uncovers uncredited mentions and missed citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode, helping your brand earn recognition and improve Citation Score through the GenAI Visibility Stack.
- [Explicit Wins](https://wellows.com/features/content-opportunities/): Wellows' Explicit Wins finds missed competitor citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode, revealing topics and intent opportunities to improve your AI visibility and Citation Score.
- [Commentary](https://wellows.com/features/commentary/): Wellows' Commentary turns AI visibility metrics from the GenAI Visibility Stack into actionable insights on core performance, trends and competitors across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.
- [Daily Update](https://wellows.com/features/daily-update/): Wellows' Daily Update tracks your brand's AI visibility with refreshed Citation Score, mentions and competitor shifts across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode through the autonomous marketing platform.
- [Validator](https://wellows.com/features/validator/): Wellows' Validator verifies AI citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode, ensuring your Citation Score and AI visibility data stays accurate through the GenAI Visibility Stack.
- [Multiple LLMs](https://wellows.com/features/multiple-llms/): Wellows shows how your brand performs across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode, providing comprehensive AI visibility and Citation Score comparisons through the GenAI Visibility Stack.
- [Citation Score](https://wellows.com/features/ai-visibility-score/): Wellows' Citation Score turns verified AI citations from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode into one unified metric for measuring AI visibility through the GenAI Visibility Stack.
- [Outreach](https://wellows.com/features/outreach/): Wellows' Outreach turns missed mentions into citations by connecting you with verified publishers, helping improve Citation Score and AI visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.
- [Content Scoring](https://wellows.com/features/content-scoring/): Wellows' Content Scoring reviews readability, originality and factual accuracy using GenAI Visibility Stack standards, ensuring every draft earns trust and improves Citation Score and AI visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode.

## Free Tools by Wellows
- [Query Fan-Out Generator](https://wellows.com/tools/query-fan-out/): Query Fan-Out Generator by Wellows expands a single keyword into high-intent, semantically rich variants that mirror how modern AI search engines interpret user intent. Generate, filter, localize, and export structured query variants across eight AI-recognized types — free and without login. Perfect for content planning, PPC research, topical expansion, and improving AI search visibility.
